content: this legal case took place in the klaipėda district court and involves two parties the plaintiff and the defendant the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between the parties the court has declared that 50 registered ordinary shares belong to the plaintiff as personal property and a car specifically a citroen c5 belongs to the defendant as personal property without compensation to the plaintiff the court has also recognized the plaintiffs creditors and their personal credit obligations the legal text discusses various articles of the civil code related to the division of assets and obligations between spouses in a marriage the plaintiff is requesting the dissolution of their marriage and the declaration of the car as the property of the defendant the plaintiff also owns shares in a company called uab g and has outstanding debts to creditors the court has ordered the defendant to pay various costs associated with the case including stamp duty and professional fees the court has also ordered the defendant to reimburse the state for the costs of secondary legal aid and the service of procedural documents

metadata.cost: - € 132,00 (stamp duty) + € 378,10 (professional fees) + € 14,16 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant; € 867,00 (stamp duty) to be borne by the plaintiff
